name: Adams County, CO
findings: Adams County has 1,077 nonprofit organizations. 454 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 359 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Adams County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few youth organizations list membership
observations.text: 11 youth organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 25 would.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through youth groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 112 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 112 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
